The title and all eight author names match Crossref metadata for DOI 10.1080/15391523.2025.2557392.

design_class=synthesis, context_class=synthesis, and core=no are supported: the source describes a meta-analysis, with no original randomized people study described (OpenAlex abstract, sentence 1). This does not classify randomization in its underlying studies.
synthesis.k_studies=56 and the total of 9,643 participants match the abstract; the latter counts participants across studies, not texts, ideas, or ratings (OpenAlex abstract, sentence 2).

The only reported string, the pooled estimate, and the numeric portion of the one-line finding match: SMD = 0.54, described as a moderate positive effect; 56 studies and 9,643 participants (OpenAlex abstract, sentences 2-3).
R version 4.3.2 is stated exactly (OpenAlex abstract, sentence 3).

No confidence interval, effect-size count, search end date, or standardization denominator is stated; leaving these unknown is supported. The outcome being pooled is students’ creative thinking (entire OpenAlex abstract).

The abstract provides no per-study sample sizes, arm counts, exclusions, or randomized-versus-analyzed breakdown; whether any underlying experiment analyzed fewer than 50 people cannot be checked (entire OpenAlex abstract).
summary: The abstract confirms a synthesis of 56 studies, 9,643 total participants, and SMD = 0.54. Several design, outcome, AI-scope, and disclosure fields exceed what this source supports; no original randomized people study is described.
